items.raw_excerpt: Bottled water is being handed out to passengers and staff while the issue is investigated.
items.summary_en: A water supply problem at Gatwick Airport has left passengers unable to flush toilets. Bottled water is being distributed to travelers and staff while engineers investigate the issue. The outage has caused disruption at one of the UK's busiest airports.
items.summary_ko: 개트위크 공항에서 수도 공급 문제가 발생해 승객들이 변기를 사용할 수 없게 됐다. 공항 측은 문제를 조사하는 동안 승객과 직원들에게 생수를 제공하고 있다. 영국에서 가장 붐비는 공항 중 하나인 이곳에 큰 불편이 발생했다.
items.title_en: Gatwick water outage leaves passengers without flushing toilets
items.title_ko: 개트위크 공항 수도 사고로 승객들 화장실 이용 불편
items.title_original: Gatwick water outage leave passengers without flushing toilets

items.raw_excerpt: IMC to scale down operations at the repatriation centre in Musina from 20 000 capacity to 1 500
items.summary_en: The Inter-Ministerial Committee is reducing operations at the Musina repatriation centre. The facility's capacity will drop from 20,000 people to just 1,500. This is part of a change in how the centre handles returning citizens.
items.summary_ko: 장관급 위원회는 무시나 귀환 센터의 운영을 축소하고 있다. 시설의 수용 인원은 2만 명에서 1,500명으로 줄어들게 된다. 이는 귀환하는 시민들을 처리하는 방식의 변화에 따른 것이다.
items.title_en: South African government scales down Musina repatriation centre
items.title_ko: 남아프리카공화국, 무시나 귀환 센터 규모 축소
items.title_original: IMC to scale down operations at Musina repatriation centre

items.raw_excerpt: Với mong muốn tạo thêm điểm hẹn văn hóa, thương mại và du lịch đặc sắc, Chợ phiên chủ đề Làng trong phố do UBND phường Hòa Xuân (Đà Nẵng) tổ chức lần đầu tiên chính thức khai mạc tối 25-7, thu hút đông đảo người dân và du khách đến tham quan, trải nghiệm và mua sắm.
items.summary_en: A new cultural and commercial fair called Village in the City opened for the first time in Hoa Xuan Ward, Da Nang. The local ward government organized the event to create a new cultural and shopping destination. Many residents and tourists came to browse stalls and enjoy the festivities.
items.summary_ko: 베트남 다낭시 호아쑤엔구에서 도시 속 마을이라는 테마의 문화 상업 장터가 처음으로 개장했습니다. 구청이 주최한 이 행사는 지역 주민과 관광객들에게 새로운 문화 및 쇼핑 명소를 제공하기 위해 마련되었습니다. 많은 사람들이 찾아와 각종 상점과 체험 부스를 둘러보며 장터를 즐겼습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Roundabouts are excellent traffic movers, better actually than traffic lights, though these can also be useful at certain spots.
items.summary_en: Roundabouts help traffic move better than traffic lights in many places. But traffic lights can still be useful at certain spots in the Algarve region.
items.summary_ko: 회전교차로는 신호등보다 교통 흐름을 더 잘 도와줍니다. 하지만 특정 장소에서는 신호등이 여전히 유용합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Free reconstructive surgery for children born with cleft lip is under way at Rob Ferreira Hospital
items.summary_en: Free surgery is being offered to children born with cleft lip at Rob Ferreira Hospital. The hospital is providing reconstructive procedures at no cost to families. Cleft lip is a condition where the upper lip does not form completely during pregnancy.
items.summary_ko: 로브 페레이라 병원에서 구순열로 태어난 아이들에게 무료 수술을 제공하고 있습니다. 병원은 가족들에게 비용 부담 없이 재건 시술을 시행하고 있습니다. 구순열은 임신 중 윗입술이 완전히 형성되지 않는 선천성 상태입니다.
items.title_en: Free cleft lip surgeries under way at Rob Ferreira Hospital

items.raw_excerpt: Mexico's axolotl is a remarkable creature, but although very well represented in the pet trade, it's disappearing from the wild.
items.summary_en: The axolotl is a famous creature from Mexico. It is very popular as a pet around the world, but it is disappearing from its natural home in the wild. Saving the axolotl in nature is now a big international effort.
items.summary_ko: 아홀로틀은 멕시코에 사는 특별한 생물입니다. 전 세계에서 반려동물로 인기가 많지만, 자연에서는 급격히 줄고 있습니다. 지금 국제 사회가 아홀로틀을 자연에서 보호하려는 노력을 기울이고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Mexico's Critically Endangered Axolotl Is an International Success
items.title_ko: 멕시코의 멸종 위기 아홀로틀, 세계적인 인기 얻어
items.title_original: Mexico’s critically endangered axolotl proves an international success

items.raw_excerpt: Flights were not reported to be affected, but passengers posted online that they were unable to flush toilets, get hot drinks, wash their hands or fill up water bottles
items.summary_en: London's Gatwick Airport had a water outage that affected people in the terminal. Passengers said they could not flush toilets, get hot drinks, wash hands, or fill water bottles. Flights were not reported to be affected.
items.summary_ko: 런던 개트윅 공항에서 수도 공급이 중단되어 터미널 이용 승객들이 불편을 겪었습니다. 승객들은 화장실 사용, 뜨거운 음료 제공, 손씻기, 물병 충전 등이 불가능했다고 온라인에 알렸습니다. 항공편 운항에는 영향이 없는 것으로 확인되었습니다.
items.title_en: Water Outage at London Gatwick Airport Inconveniences Passengers
items.title_ko: 런던 개트윅 공항 수도 중단으로 승객들 불편
items.title_original: London's Gatwick Airport suffers water outage

items.raw_excerpt: The public tender for the enhancement of the Monte de São Julião archaeological site in Albergaria-a-Velha was published in the Diário da República (Official Gazette), with a base value of €165,000.
items.summary_en: Portugal has published a public tender to improve the Monte de São Julião archaeological site in Albergaria-a-Velha. The project has a base value of 165,000 euros. The site is located in the Aveiro district.

items.summary_en: Brazil's public radio broadcaster Radio Nacional will air the football match between Cruzeiro and Botafogo this Sunday. Coverage starts at 3:30 PM local time. The match is part of the national football league schedule.

items.raw_excerpt: Chimney swifts, a threatened migratory bird species, have taken up residence in a Winnipeg couple's 91-year-old home.
items.summary_en: A pair of chimney swifts, a threatened migratory bird species, have made a Winnipeg couple's 91-year-old house their new home. The birds nested inside the chimney and earned the nickname 'musical roommates' from the homeowners. The couple is now protecting the birds' habitat as part of conservation efforts.
items.summary_ko: 멸종위기 철새인 굴뚝제비 한 쌍이 위니백의 한 부부가 사는 91년 된 집에 보금자리를 마련했다. 굴뚝 안에 둥지를 틀고 지내며 부부에게 '음악적 룸메이트'라는 별명을 얻었다. 부부는 보호 노력을 위해 굴뚝제비 서식지를 지키기로 했다.
items.title_en: Threatened chimney swifts move into Winnipeg couple's 91-year-old home
items.title_ko: 위협받는 굴뚝제비, 위니백 부부의 91년 된 집으로 이사 오다
items.title_original: Winnipeg couple becomes unwitting hosts to 'musical roommates' as threatened chimney swifts move in

items.raw_excerpt: Galway’s Kylemore Abbey has announced a conservation plan for its historic Victorian model farm.
items.summary_en: Galway's Kylemore Abbey has announced a plan to restore and conserve its historic Victorian model farm. The project aims to preserve the heritage site for future generations.

items.title_en: Kylemore Abbey in Galway announces conservation plan for Victorian model farm

items.raw_excerpt: Eastern Cape MEC for Agriculture, Nonceba Kontsiwe, is set to hand over critical investments aimed at strengthening food security, supporting rural enterprises and empowering women and youth in the Joe Gqabi District Municipality.
items.summary_en: The Eastern Cape government is giving important help to farmers and small textile companies. The support aims to improve food security and help rural businesses grow. It also focuses on empowering women and young people in the Joe Gqabi District.
